title: Port- words, false friends, -ité
summary: From porter you get exporter, importer, transporter and emporter (à emporter = to take away). Watch out for false friends: supporter means to put up with, not to support. You also learn bien (well), se comporter (to behave), saisir (to seize), and that -ity → -ité (feminine).
points: port- words: exporter, importer, déporter, transporter, emporter.
False friend: supporter = to tolerate / put up with. Je peux le supporter = I can put up with him.
bien = well. It goes before the verb that follows: Je dois bien me comporter.
-ity → -ité, always feminine: la possibilité, la probabilité, la nécessité, l'opportunité.
saisir = to seize. ai sounds like è. A single s between vowels sounds like z.
vocab: to tolerate, put up with (false friend!)
drills: I can put up with him.
You have to seize the opportunity.
He has to seize the opportunity.
